purpose: Continue from the actual R10 GNC-r3 material-execution progress, replace the12-start cap with evidence/time constraints, establish a frozen same-version complete mission, and advance real continuous PPO/PANN/MPC and600s evaluation. This contract contains no R11 results.

history.rule: New user-requested R11 campaign; preserve all R10 counts/results/contracts/assets. Do not repurpose or overwrite the closed R10 run.

configuration_reuse.rule: Reuse actual GNC-r3 physics/execution, R9 PANN/features/reward and R10 PPO implementation unless explicitly overridden here. R11 owns identity, budgets, continuous curriculum and priority order. Adapt all R10 hard-coded paths/counts and runner stage conditions; changingJSON alone is insufficient. Emit the fully resolved actual config before physics.

plant_invariants.robot: project four-legged Go2, 15.206408 kg; original geometry/inertia/passive parameters/limits; G0/G1 are historical cohort labels, not humanoid hardware
plant_invariants.material: unchanged ReferenceColumns tm02_anchor and original constitutive parameters
plant_invariants.boundary_rule: unchanged hard-priority footprint assignment, unique support; retain non-foot collisions
plant_invariants.history_rule: World-fixed shared columns recover when unloaded. Reset only between independent episodes/acquisition sessions, never at PPO updates, laps or file boundaries.
plant_invariants.prohibited: softening truth to pass, clipping material strain/force, injecting planned GRF, relaxing task/physical limits, replacing the training plant or controller

controller_development.new_controller_name: S5 only upon implementation; preserve S3 and all S4/R10 builds
controller_development.physical_accounting: Every task with any real integration counts, including early physical failures, crashes and missing records. Zero-step setup failures remain logged and consume wall time. No blind repeat of same infrastructure failure.
controller_development.first_work: On the execution host read existing dev11 last0.5s and planned trajectories plus maximum-lateral-drift window; compare dev10/dev12. Correct the old1ms/native-only contact analysis before using it for C. No new short diagnostic episodes.
evidence_fields: nominal and executed feedback joint targets
decision_branches: Predicted fast landing: repair consistent normal/support/body/foot reference and objective priorities inside the same MPC.
Predicted slow but actual fast: repair local contact/feedback/discrete derivative/execution mismatch; candidate forces must follow candidate states.
Path/support transition evidence: repair same-MPC reference and boundary transition handling without bypassing or changing the truth strip.
controller_development.allowed_scope: Evidence-backed local model, objective, reference and necessary contact-timing revisions within existing raw MuJoCo whole-body iLQG+PD. No fixed three-formulation cap; each actual version is identified and retained.
controller_development.stop_rule: Freeze at first same-version nominal original material mission with full60s observation. Otherwise development ends at24h or evaluation-reserve limit. Two successive evidence batches stop only the current branch when BOTH no relevant improvement AND no new testable mechanism exist; other feasible work continues. Do not repeat deterministic failure without new evidence or automatically extend the campaign.
controller_development.formal_version_rule: No tuning after formal freeze. A required new controller revision ends the previous formal version's scope; do not combine best outcomes or silently continue policies on changed dynamics.

joint_learning.fixed_group_cap: first successful predeclared development cap, frozen before evaluation
joint_learning.actor_action: single speed cap [.18,.25] m/s; .215+.035*sample.action, where existing sample.action is already tanh(raw); retain raw action/log_prob
joint_learning.shared_controller: All three groups use the same actually frozen S5, real Go2/TM02, limits and interfaces; shared execution repairs are not PANN gains.
joint_learning.shared_observation: Retain R9 public proprioception, task phase/goal/strip information and preceding1s at20Hz. Keep the existing schema but set the old finite-task flag and remaining-time channels to zero for continuous training, formal60s and every long evaluation. Do not expose an unseen finite-task countdown after600s-only training. The evaluator still enforces original60s deadlines/termination. No true material q/e.
joint_learning.pann: Frozen B_random1000--ideal seed0 and original normalization; independent causal LearnedColumns world state, no true material q/e input
joint_learning.pann_features: Preserve R9 2 ms causal observer, latest completed plan t+.20 s four footprints, private zero-load recovery at2/200/500 ms and12 area-weighted signed depressions. Shared public query positions/masks; RAW prediction channels zero. Match world keys, not array row indices; queries do not alter truth or observer.
joint_learning.observer_preparation: Can proceed alongside controller development using existing causal trajectories. Replay/network loading is not closed-loop success or PPO training.

ppo.implementation: existing standard Tianshou PPO core; no algorithm/platform replacement
ppo.device: Resolve on authorized hardware once before training; use the same actor/critic device policy for both groups. A small PPO network need not be enlarged to occupy VRAM.

joint_learning.primary_checkpoint_rule: Exactly32768/stream if all reach it; otherwise the last common completed256-step checkpoint before the empirically budgeted evaluation deadline. Label undertraining. No performance-selected seed/checkpoint. If no common updated checkpoint exists, do not label initial weights as trained.
joint_learning.optional_training_rule: Only after all six32768 standard checkpoints exist and core evaluation is completed under evaluation.core_completion_rule, resume all six equally toward65536 within the remaining authorized time. Optional weights do not replace primary checkpoints. No second unbudgeted formal matrix.
joint_learning.sampling_accounting: Record total/effective translating transitions, elapsed physics, actual resets, failures, PPO updates and component/campaign wall times. Stand/turn observations may be collected but separately count ineffective actions; no passive post-completion padding.
joint_learning.on_policy_and_independence: Separate parameters, optimizer, normalizers, seeds and environment/MPC/material/observer state for each stream. Collect each256-transition fragment under its fixed behavior policy; update only that stream and then continue its state. Do not mix other seeds or stale-policy fragments to fake on-policy data. Archive frozen evaluation normalizers with checkpoints.

curriculum.end_semantics: Physical/material failure terminates;600s acquisition boundary truncates. Original60s is used for qualification/formal evaluation, not a prerequisite sample-count curriculum.

joint_learning.curriculum_boundary_rule: Long continuous sampling starts with the first actual training session after controller qualification. No8192/16384 gate. No reset at256-transition rollout or lap boundaries. Reset only after actual terminal or explicitly recorded independent-session truncation.
joint_learning.continuing_route: Endless0-to3-to0m circuits during each600s training session; stop2s under original thresholds at each endpoint and really turn before the next leg/lap. Completion of a lap is not session termination. No per-lap material or MPC reset, and no training parking after a fixed target lap count.
joint_learning.bootstrap_rule: True terminal: bootstrap0. Rollout cut: bootstrap actual successor and keep environment alive. External600s truncation: bootstrap saved final pre-reset observation, stop GAE recursion across the subsequent reset. Use distinct bootstrap and trace-continuation masks; never bootstrap reset observation or propagate advantages into the next episode. Technical interruption is not physical failure.
joint_learning.start_condition: At least one same-version nominal material original mission completes and is observed through60s. No requirement for all initial conditions or prior600s success.
joint_learning.resume_required: Implement R11 paths/stage branches and actual budget routing. Restore actor/critic, optimizer, normalization, RNG, samples/updates and episode numbers; do not overwrite prior output. Only complete physics/material/observer/MPC snapshots permit continuous-session resume; otherwise record technical truncation and begin a separate session.

reward_adaptation.base: Frozen R9 physical progress/time/indentation/slip/applied-action-change reward and weights; no reward for predicted material or assumed beneficial compaction
reward_adaptation.rate_rule: Retain original dt/60 denominators and physical normalization in every training stage. Do not divide costs by300/600 or reweight to favor long sessions. Integrate actual dt, not nominal dt after early termination.
reward_adaptation.progress: Unwrapped signed actual translational progress divided by6m per circuit; split phase changes, include backward motion, no position-reset or phase-switch progress bonus.
reward_adaptation.events: Original single-task completion gives+10 once and terminates. In continuing stages give+10 once per fully completed circuit after original home stability, then continue. No completion reward for merely standing or at the far endpoint. Physical/material failure gives-10 once. Intrinsic60s timeout gives-5 without duplicate failure penalty; external600s truncation or technical deadline gives no timeout/failure penalty. Original finite-task reward semantics are retained for reference/evaluation; they do not authorize a60s R11 training curriculum.
reward_adaptation.freeze: Same adapted reward and task semantics in both learning groups before training. No reward or hyperparameter sweep and no formal-result tuning.
reward_adaptation.interpretation: Long continuous execution is not proof of long-delay credit assignment; gamma remains.99 and the material memory time is determined by actual physics.

evaluation.freeze: Primary common checkpoints and normalizers fixed for entire evaluation trajectories; deterministic policy mean; no PPO updates during formal tests. PANN estimated states and MPC still evolve causally.

original_material.composition: 3 fixed +2 learned groups x3 training seeds x3 initial conditions
original_material.criteria: Unchanged original single mission; observe through60s, no newly added far-end hold

continuous_material.composition: 3 fixed +2 learned groups x3 training seeds x3 initial conditions; do not reduce learned coverage to seed0
continuous_material.start_rule: Each frozen group/seed qualifies by its own nominal60s complete observation; fixed nominal600s starts immediately, remaining conditions follow priority manifest and actual budget. No prerequisite300s campaign.
continuous_material.observation_rule: After10 circuits continue holding and record to600s; separately report moving/holding time, route completion and subsequent violations. Treat300s as an in-trajectory observation, not an independent extra trial.

extended_continuous_material.start_rule: Own same-version nominal600s passes, all core completed and estimated1800s wall time fits; fixed/learned seed0 only.
Own same-version nominal1800s passes, all core completed and estimated3600s uninterrupted wall time fits; fixed/learned seed0 only.

evaluation.all_long_tasks: Original stability tolerances,2s holds at both endpoints and actual turns; no lap resets or stitched runs. At route completion hold until declared horizon and require final continuous2s stability; report every violation, final30s and each lap/60s segment. Failures terminate truthfully and remain in denominators. All durations are simulation time, not wall time.
evaluation.reuse: Exactly same source/config/checkpoint/initial state/protocol may be reused once. A shorter run or prefix is not an independent longer task; new durations are separately declared.
evaluation.interpretation: Three seeds and deterministic initial offsets are limited coverage, not held-out material generalization or robot certification. Joint execution, PANN changing actions and task gains are separate outcomes.

priority_schedule.tasks: One same-version nominal material60s qualification, one rigid60s regression after freezing.
priority_schedule.reuse: identical full qualification may be reused once

priority_schedule.tasks: Fixed3 initial-condition60s and fixed nominal600s immediately after nominal qualification; do not wait for PPO.

Balanced6-stream training to common actual checkpoint; schedule each predeclared RAW/PANN seed0 nominal600s immediately after that same policy passes nominal60s. Other learned policies nominal60s may run in parallel or later; no all-policy qualification barrier.
Remaining predeclared21x60s and21x600s cases in fixed manifest order; preserve unrun cases and reasons.
Predeclared fixed/learned seed0 1800s then3600s only after own preceding-duration pass, all core completion and enough actual wall time.

evaluation.coverage_rule: The complete21+21 target remains. Priority nominal long tasks are explicitly a partial subset; do not report them as all21. No best-seed substitution, hidden manifest reduction or mixed-version outcomes.

evaluation.core_completion_rule: All eligible predeclared core cases have actually run (pass or fail); ineligible cases remain listed with their failed qualification. Budget-omitted eligible cases are still incomplete core work. A failed/ineligible method does not cancel other eligible methods; no optional extension before the remaining eligible core work is completed.

authorized_existing_hardware.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

resources.rule: Use CPU quota, not208 visible affinity entries. Coordinate env/solver/BLAS/OpenMP/PyTorch/JAX resources; preserve per-stream independence. Adjust only from actual full missions/fragments, without interrupting sessions or starting benchmarks.
resources.performance_scope: Reduce redundant RPC/FK/logging and batch material arithmetic/reuse constants without changing the true .2ms material integration, .2ms physics,2ms action holding, persistent unloaded recovery or fair information. No fast substitute controller/plant.

budget.starts_at: first real R11 physics integration; one elapsed deadline including pauses and all later development/build/training/evaluation
budget.reserve_rule: Reserve max(6h,1.2x measured remaining scheduling wall cost). Protect fixed P1 and fair nominal P2 first if complete21+21 exceeds remaining time; keep P3 manifest unexecuted reasons. Do not make an infeasible full-matrix reservation prohibit all training; do not assume perfect speedup.
budget.targets_and_extensions: 32768/flow remains target,65536 and1800/3600 conditional. All full targets require actual throughput and authorized time; no automatic extension or reset.
budget.interpretation: These are conditional extrapolations from one short run, not measured long-task throughput. Material-state growth, observer cost and CPU contention may change cost. Additional environments do not remove each policy's serial600->1800->3600 dependency.
